nature_language: 当前位置杭州。我和朋友计划去北京玩三天，选择飞机出行，预算8000元，开一间双床房。请给我一个旅行规划。
nature_language_en: Current location: Hangzhou. My friend and I are planning to visit Beijing for three days. We have chosen to travel by plane and have a budget of 8,000 RMB. We will book a twin room. Please provide me with a travel itinerary.
